properties.name: Yarim
properties.selection: purposive: most roofs a PV classifier scores as likely
properties.note: Chosen by scripts/propose_calibration_candidates.py --pv-rich to add rooftop positives to the roofclf fit: the 1 km window with the most household roofs (under 400 m2) scoring in the national top 5% (180 of 1,999 buildings, 1,999 per km2, VIDA). Chosen ON a PV score, so it is where solar is likely: map every installation, ground and rooftop, and record roofs without solar as carefully as roofs with it. Esri imagery here dates from 2025-06-04 (oldest of centre and corners), no older than 2024-10-01 for a composite starting 2025-10-01.
